entities.title: Where and how to publish Neon Cycles
entities.summary: Neon Cycles is published from this repository at icelander.net/games/retro/neon-cycles, behind the sign-in, with the Compatibility renderer.
entities.context: The game was made as a stand-alone Godot 4 project with the Forward+ renderer. The web needs WebGL 2, which only the Compatibility renderer targets, and the engine file (about 38 MiB) is over Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit for a static file, so icelander.net's own Worker could not serve it as it is.

options.title: In this repository, as Gambit is
options.consequences: Its own Worker behind the sign-in, the engine split into parts that the Worker joins, and Godot in the workflow.

options.title: In the icelander.net repository, with the engine in R2
options.consequences: Changes the site's Worker to serve the engine from a bucket.

entities.decision: Publish it from this repository, like Gambit, with the Compatibility renderer and no threads.
entities.rationale: The owner chose this repository. The Compatibility renderer keeps the glow; it loses screen-space reflections and ambient occlusion, which the Forward+ build had.
